description: This PHP class defines the AWS DataPipeline client, providing methods to interact with AWS Data Pipeline services such as creating, deleting, and managing pipelines, as well as executing associated operations. It extends the AwsClient base class and defines method signatures for various pipeline-related actions.

classes.name: DataPipelineClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with the AWS Data Pipeline service, providing methods for pipeline management and data processing operations.

methods.name: addTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a specified pipeline.

methods.name: describeObjects
methods.description: Returns detailed metadata for objects in a pipeline.

methods.name: getPipelineDefinition
methods.description: Returns the definition of a pipeline.

methods.name: listPipelines
methods.description: Lists the pipelines associated with the account.

methods.name: pollForTask
methods.description: Polls for a task to be executed.

methods.name: putPipelineDefinition
methods.description: Adds or updates the definition of a pipeline.

methods.name: reportTaskRunnerHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends heartbeat signals for task runners.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of a pipeline.

methods.name: setTaskStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of a task.
